summary: Factorial Energy Inc. (f/k/a Cartesian Growth Corp III) filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its business combination with Factorial Inc. on June 5, 2026. The transaction involved a domestication from Cayman Islands to Delaware, a merger of Merger Sub with Factorial, and a name change. No consideration terms were disclosed. The board recommended the deal. The filing is a de-SPAC closing; no risk-arb remains as the deal closed.
